ayahs.1: By the heaven and the nightly star—
ayahs.2: and what will make you realize what the nightly star is?
ayahs.3: It is the star of piercing brightness.
ayahs.4: There is no soul without a vigilant guardian recording its deeds.
ayahs.5: Let people consider what they were created from:
ayahs.7: issued from between the backbone and the ribcage.
ayahs.8: Surely He is able to bring them back to life
ayahs.9: on the Day all secrets are laid bare.
ayahs.10: Then one will have neither power nor helper.
ayahs.11: By the sky that returns rain again and again,
ayahs.12: and the earth that splits open for growth—
ayahs.13: this Qur'an is a decisive word,
ayahs.17: So bear with those who reject the truth a little longer.
